anchor.quote: Let $f$ be the parameter of a call
Here $m$ is the factor by which the parameter grows
Let $T(f)$ be the normalized cost of a call at parameter $f$
giving a geometric series with ratio $q=\frac{s/W}{m^\lambda}$

gaps.quote: the number of field digits for address interchange
gaps.note: The reader does not know what address interchange is, and this page neither explains it nor links to the Fast interchange of address fields page. The parameter f is defined through it.

gaps.quote: of selected axes for a numerical layer
gaps.note: The reader does not know what a numerical layer is, and the page neither explains nor links it. It is part of the meaning given for the parameter f.

gaps.quote: The outside work at a node of parameter $mf$ is at most $C(mf)^\lambda$, for a constant $C$ and an exponent $\lambda<1$.
gaps.note: The page asserts that outside work at a node is at most C(mf)^lambda without saying why the procedures satisfy this bound. It also does not say that this work is divided by V, although the recurrence adds it to the normalized cost T. The reader cannot check the bound or its normalization from the page.

gaps.quote: and $T(f)$ is at most a constant times $f^\lambda$ (cited)
gaps.note: The page applies a cited bound as the conclusion of the unrolled series but does not say the depth of the unrolling or the base-case cost. Without these, the reader cannot check that the cited bound applies to every f.
